title: Identify the full names and email addresses of members who incurred expense
question: Identify the full names and email addresses of members who incurred expenses on 'Posters' for events categorized under an 'Advertisement' budget, where the budgeted amount was among the top three highest in that category.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_ad_budgets AS (
  SELECT XCL_003
  FROM budget
  WHERE XCL_004 = 'Advertisement'
  ORDER BY XCL_007 DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036, m.XCL_037
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
JOIN top_ad_budgets t ON b.XCL_003 = t.XCL_003
JOIN member m ON e.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034
WHERE e.XCL_018 = 'Posters'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT XCL_003,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY XCL_005 DESC) AS rn
  FROM budget
  WHERE XCL_004 = 'Advertisement'
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.XCL_035 || ' ' || m.XCL_036 AS full_name, m.XCL_037 AS email
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
JOIN ranked r ON b.XCL_003 = r.XCL_003
JOIN member m ON e.XCL_022 = m.XCL_034
WHERE e.XCL_018 = 'Posters'
  AND b.XCL_004 = 'Advertisement'
  AND r.rn <= 3
